summary: Compared the corrected 1920 px source/render/diff crop for about-grain-trade, verified sourced WYSIWYG and the actual image request. Outer geometry passes (expected 160,1454,1600x631; actual 160,1454.421875,1600x631) and the crop ratio is 8.3363%, but two concrete fidelity defects remain.
issues: VIS-ABOUT-GRAIN-001 | priority: high | property: list markers | expected: all three rich-text list items show circular bullets at the source indentation | actual: the rendered crop preserves text indentation but suppresses all three bullet glyphs | fix: restore source list-style markers for this WYSIWYG list without changing sourced text or the passing card geometry.

VIS-ABOUT-GRAIN-002 | priority: medium | property: photo source rendition/raster quality | expected: the exact 960x640 sourced attachment is downsampled into the 588x450 cover box | actual: runtime metrics request the 600x400 WordPress intermediate and upscale it into the 588x450 cover box, producing extensive interior photo-edge differences | fix: request the full source attachment (or a sufficiently large non-upscaled rendition) while retaining object-fit cover, the current crop and border geometry.
